title: KDIGO 2012 AKI guideline
application: AKI definitions/staging and KRT principles; local profile approval required.

title: KDIGO AKI/AKD update status
application: 2026 update being prepared for publication; do not activate a public-review draft.

title: KDIGO 2026 AKI/AKD public-review draft
application: Change-tracking reference; excluded from active protocol authority.

title: STARRT-AKI investigators, NEJM 2020
application: Accelerated strategy did not reduce 90-day mortality in the studied population; does not justify delaying urgent indications.

title: RENAL investigators, NEJM 2009
application: Higher intensity was not superior for mortality; retain delivered-dose and electrolyte monitoring.

title: VA/NIH ATN, NEJM 2008
application: No outcome advantage from the studied intensive strategy; do not turn dose targets into automatic escalation.

title: RICH trial, JAMA 2020
application: Citrate versus systemic heparin filter-life evidence; applicability and bleeding/metabolic context remain local decisions.

title: SIAARTI–SIN citrate expert opinion 2023
application: Site-specific calcium monitoring, metabolic context and formulation-specific protocols; not a pump-control specification.

title: NIDDK drug dosing and kidney function
application: Different estimate/measurement methods and BSA bases need explicit labeling and drug-specific review.

title: KDIGO 2024 CKD guideline
application: Longitudinal CKD context and medication stewardship; AKI cannot be classified as CKD by a single test.

title: ESPEN kidney nutrition practical guideline 2024
application: KRT/nutrition interface, individualized assessment; no universal protein or loss profile activated.

title: Current ClinRx renal source/entry contracts
application: RF1/RF2 exact source history and original source ownership; limited creatinine/urine/fluid/weight context.

title: Current ClinRx shared patient and M7 integration
application: Reuse shared catalog and pending command guards; preserve the work in ClinRx main.
